runtimeContract: Start matched, require every character in the whole-party or picked set to have the condition, or test Castle's directly indexed party position, then branch to the success or failure XAP with the authored GOSUB flag.
sourceQuirks: Castle directly indexes positive candidate modes even though Divinity labels one as the top character, and never reads the documented failure-message field. Empty picked sets remain matched.
determinism: The operation consumes no RNG and reads only save-owned character conditions and selected identities.
